courseHelp.title: How this course works
courseHelp.body:
Write your program in the editor. Press **Run** to try the sample tests. Press **Submit** to check all tests. A green check means your program printed the right text.

Each test can type an **input** for your program. `input()` reads one line of it. Big and small letters, spaces between words, and punctuation must match. Spaces at the end of a line do not matter.

If you see `Error on line 3`, look at line 3 of your code. Check quotes, `:`, and the 4 spaces in front of lines inside an `if`.

Stuck? Open a hint. The solution tab shows one correct answer. Try first!

hints: `elif score >= 80:` shows `B`. Scores of 90 or more never reach this line.
